description: This file declares the DrmSystemWidevine class, which adapts Widevine's Content Decryption Module to Starboard's DRM system interface. It includes method declarations for session management, decryption, and event handling, as well as internal data structures and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: DrmSystemWidevine
classes.description: A class that implements Widevine DRM integration for Starboard, handling session management, message passing, key status updates, and server certificate handling.

methods.name: DrmSystemWidevine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Widevine DRM system with context and callback functions.

methods.name: IsKeySystemSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system is supported.

methods.name: IsDrmSystemWidevine
methods.description: Checks if a given DRM system is Widevine.

methods.name: GenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Generates a session update request with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with a key.
